# DSH Studio v0.9.25

## 新功能

- “快捷操作”成为独立页面，提供进入 Harness、终端、会话、插件、配置管理和工作区选择的六个入口，直接显示当前配置与工作区。

## 变更与安全

- 中间视图由“扩展”改名为“快捷操作”，英文由 Extended 改为 Quick actions；保留既有界面偏好值，升级无需重设。三个视图增加悬停说明，使用指南与设置文字同步更新。
- 切换至快捷操作或控制面板时保留已加载的 Harness 窗口；返回时继续原有会话。工作区拖放根据当前可见界面处理，快捷操作沿用原生工作区选择流程。
- 继续沿用现有原生命令、权限和数据存储边界，公开 Protocol 3 与 Host Protocol 1 保持不变。

## 修复与打磨

- 提示库、工作区文件浏览、会话批量整理及个人资料弹窗统一采用现有控件尺寸、字号与圆角。
- 统一启动向导、会话详情、演示文稿编辑器和设置页的同排按钮高度；状态栏更新提示与相邻区段等高。
- 已安装插件的图标和名称合并为一个详情点击目标，安装和卸载按钮仍独立；插件详情链接采用统一按钮样式。
- 补齐截图预览数据中的提示库、个人会话资料与工作区文件示例；更新中英文说明和文档检查。

## 验证

- 本地 685 项前端、577 项执行的 Rust 和 158 项打包测试通过，前端行覆盖率 99.36%；生产构建及体积预算、严格 Clippy、lint、公开权限合同、Tauri 版本配对、可访问性及双语文档检查通过。
- 真实 Windows WebView 在深浅主题和 900×620、1100×740、1440×900 三种尺寸下完成 10 个页面共 60 次导航；快捷入口、Harness 窗口保留、已安装插件图标打开详情、提示编辑/导入、文件目录与文本预览、会话整理/批量整理实际点击通过。
- Windows 原生光标控制被系统拒绝，本轮未验证系统文件选择器的操作、付费模型调用或 macOS/Linux 物理真机 GUI；上述本地证据不替代这些场景的验收。
- 发布流水线继续执行各平台运行时冷安装与启动、Lite/Full 打包、安装应用及离线资源验收；通过后才正式发布。

## 安装

- 可覆盖升级 v0.9.24，保留运行时、配置、会话、个人资料及界面偏好。
- 提供 Windows x64、Linux x64、macOS Apple Silicon、Intel 和 Universal；Lite 按需安装运行时，Full/Offline 携带运行资源。Windows 便携版需完整解压并保留 EXE 旁的 dist/。
- 应用内更新使用签名更新清单。更新包签名与操作系统发布者签名为独立机制。

<!-- dsh-notes:en -->
# DSH Studio v0.9.25

## New features

- Replace the former extended toolbar with a standalone Quick actions page: six entries for Harness, terminals, sessions, plugins, profiles and workspace selection, showing the active profile and workspace.

## Changes and safety

- Rename Extended to Quick actions, add descriptive view tooltips and synchronize bilingual settings and guides. Preserve stored presentation values and keep the loaded Harness frame mounted while visiting other views. Route workspace drops according to the visible surface.
- Reuse existing native commands and storage boundaries; public Protocol 3 and Host Protocol 1 remain unchanged.

## Fixes and polish

- Align prompt-library, workspace-browser, session-organizer and personal-dialog controls with shared sizes, typography and corners. Match adjacent onboarding, session, presentation and settings buttons, and make the update notice a full-height status segment.
- Make installed-plugin icons and names one detail target while retaining separate management controls; standardize detail links. Extend screenshot fixtures and bilingual documentation checks.

## Verification

- Local verification passes 685 frontend, 577 executed Rust and 158 packaging tests with 99.36% frontend line coverage, production build/budget, strict Clippy, lint, ACL/public contracts, Tauri version pairs, accessibility and bilingual documentation checks.
- Actual Windows WebView checks cover 60 navigations through ten pages across three sizes and both themes, shortcut navigation and retained Harness frames, plugin-icon detail clicks, prompt editor/import, directory/text previews and individual/batch session dialogs.
- Native cursor control was denied by Windows. OS file-picker operation, paid model calls and physical macOS/Linux GUI checks are outside this local evidence.
- Release CI continues to qualify runtime cold installs/boot and platform Lite/Full installers and offline payloads before publication.

## Installation

- Upgrade over v0.9.24 retaining runtime, profiles, sessions, personal data and presentation preference. Existing five-platform Lite/Full editions and signed updater channels continue; Windows portable builds require adjacent dist/. Updater and OS publisher signatures are separate mechanisms.

<!-- dsh-notes:end -->
